finalResult.headline: Answer
finalResult.body: Binary search is an efficient algorithm for finding a target value within a sorted list. It repeatedly divides the search interval in half: if the target is less than the middle element, the algorithm continues on the left half; if greater, it continues on the right half. This process repeats until the target is found or the interval is empty, giving a time complexity of O(log n).

Binary search is an efficient algorithm for finding a target value within a sorted list. It repeatedly divides the search interval in half: if the target is less than the middle element, the algorithm continues on the left half; if greater, it continues on the right half. This process repeats until the target is found or the interval is empty, giving a time complexity of O(log n).
